western comics style, bold ink outlines, heavy comic action hatching, frantic slapstick comedy, full-body vertical ensemble framing, wobble motion lines, textless comic illustration, no text, no title, no typography.

Character 1 (The Leader): female antlered elf brawler, young adult, green-teal hair flying wildly, small pale antlers, tan skin, black eyepatch, single green eye wide with over-the-top comic panic, mouth open in a frantic yell, teetering precariously on one foot atop the tiefling's armored shoulders, flailing both arms frantically to keep balance, a few accidental blue electric sparks popping comically from her silver gauntlet like startled firecrackers.
Character 2 (The Monk): male orc monk, massive moss-green foundation at the very bottom, standing rock-solid in a wide horse stance, arms calmly folded across his chest, eyes serenely closed in deep unshakeable meditation, completely oblivious to the panic above him.
Character 3 (The Thief): male catfolk rogue, tawny feline body stretched out in mid-air panic, tail straight up like an exclamation mark, clawing desperately onto the elf leader's fur collar from behind, ears flattened, shrieking with wide yellow eyes as he accidentally causes the whole tower to tilt.
Character 4 (The Paladin): muscular female tiefling paladin, deep red skin, massive black ram horns, standing squarely on the orc's shoulders, teeth gritted in a hilarious grimace of strain as she tries to steady the elf's wobbling ankles with her huge muscular hands, tail whipping sideways for balance.

Composition and spatial staging: a tall, wobbling vertical totem pole of characters tilting dangerously toward the right edge. The zen orc anchors the ground. The muscular tiefling strains in the middle tier. The flailing elf and clinging catfolk form an unstable, dizzying peak with curved comic balance lines.

Background and lighting: flat pure white background, stark minimalist negative space. Crisp daylight comic lighting, bold hatched shadows trailing along the curves of their muscles and armor, dramatic dark drop shadows pooling on the white floor under the orc's planted boots.

Character 1 (The Leader): female antlered elf brawler, young adult, wild tousled green-teal hair whipped back by shockwaves, pale antlers, tan skin, black eyepatch, feral reckless battle grin, sprinting straight toward the viewer through smoke, her heavy silver gauntlet thrust forward trailing roaring bolts of bright blue electric lightning and shattered padlock fragments.
Character 2 (The Monk): male orc monk, massive agile warrior, moss-green skin, bared tusks in a fierce shout, leaping sideways across the corridor, powerful linen-wrapped arms knocking aside charging guard halberds with glowing golden chi deflections.
Character 3 (The Thief): male catfolk rogue, tawny fur standing on end from adrenaline, wide yellow eyes, ears folded flat back for speed, sprinting low to the ground clutching a stolen iron keyring and heavy coin pouch, acrobatically sliding under a falling iron portcullis.

Composition and spatial staging: full-throttle escape bursting toward the foreground. The elf leader charges directly front-and-center, fist leading the vanguard. The tiefling paladin brings up the immediate rear, caught at the apex of her hammer swing that shatters the background gate. The catfolk rogue slides under the lower-right frame near the viewer's feet. The orc monk fills the upper-left midground in a spinning aerial combat maneuver.

Environment, background, and lighting: subterranean stone fortress prison dungeon violently breaking apart, shattered iron bars, splintered timber beams, and masonry chunks exploding through the air with comic motion lines. Blinding explosive backlighting from a fireball blast detonating behind the broken gate, intense fiery orange and yellow illumination casting deep stark black hatched silhouettes, violently accented by the leader's blue lightning and the paladin's golden holy aura.
